name: dzencode-test
description: Dzencode test task: Orders & Products SPA (Middle level)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && npm run lint:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w server && npm test -w client && node --test e2e/runner.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d --build --wait db && docker compose run --rm --build liquibase
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up
